izzyondroid:ch.martinstoeckli.silentnote.summary: Note taking app with optional end-to-end encrypted sync to your PC.
izzyondroid:ch.martinstoeckli.silentnote.description:
SilentNotes is a note taking app which respects your privacy. It doesn't collect personal data, runs free of ads and is an open source (FOSS) software. Write your notes in a comfortable WYSIWYG editor with basic formatting like headers or lists, and synchronize them end-to-end encrypted between Android and Windows devices.
 Beside writing of traditional notes, you can also create to-do lists to keep track of your pending tasks. Additionally the notes can be password protected with your own password, and quickly found with a full-text search.
 Take your notes wherever you are, and share them between your Android and Windows devices.
 Write the notes in an easily operated WYSIWYG editor.
 Create To-Do lists to keep an overview of your pending tasks.
 Protect selected notes with a user defined password.
 Organize and filter the notes with a tagging system.
 Quickly find the right note with the full-text search, just by typing a few letters.
 Store the notes to an online-storage of your choice (self hosting), this allows to synchronize them between devices and offers an easy backup.
 Currently supported are the FTP protocol, the WebDav protocol, Dropbox, Google-Drive and One-Drive.
 The notes never leave the device unencrypted, they are end-to-end encrypted and can only be read on your devices.
 A dark theme is available for more comfortable working in dark environment.
 Use basic formatting to structure your notes and make them more readable.
 Get a note back from the recycle-bin if it was deleted by accident.
 SilentNotes does not collect user information and requires no unnecessary privileges, thus the name silent notes.
 SilentNotes is an open source project, its source code can be verified on GitHub.
 The Windows version is available from the Microsoft store.

izzyondroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.name: NetToggle
izzyondroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.summary: 5G network control with custom Quick Settings cycles, shortcuts and automation
izzyondroid:com.dhangofa.networktoggle.description:
NetToggle is a lightweight Android Quick Settings (QS) tile app for cellular network control. Create custom tile cycles, target one or both SIMs, build shortcuts, secure broadcast automation, and troubleshoot failures with detailed diagnostics.
 ⚙️ NETWORK MODES 
 Preferred 5G (5G/4G/3G/2G) : Recommended for daily use. Allows 5G SA and NSA, including UW, UC, 5G+, or 5G++ where supported, with LTE and legacy fallback.
 5G Only (NR Only) : Disables 4G, 3G, and 2G. Intended for 5G SA networks. Service and calls may fail on NSA networks or without SA and VoNR.
 Preferred 4G (4G/3G/2G) : Disables 5G while retaining LTE and legacy fallback. Useful for battery saving, reduced heat, or unstable 5G.
 4G Only (LTE/LTE-A) : Locks to LTE without 3G/2G fallback. Calls require VoLTE; carrier aggregation is controlled by the modem and network.
 Preferred 3G (3G/2G) : Disables 4G and 5G while allowing supported 3G and 2G networks.
 2G Only (GSM/EDGE) : Locks to 2G where legacy service remains available.
 If calls or service fail in an Only mode, return to Preferred 5G or Preferred 4G.
 🔄 QUICK TILE CYCLE 
 Custom Sequence : Choose an ordered cycle of 2 or 3 modes.
 Live State : Shows the active mode with an Auto, SIM 1, SIM 2, or Both badge.
 Auto Restore : Optionally restores the last selected mode if Android, thermal management, or the carrier changes it.
 Efficient Refresh : Controlled checks avoid continuous polling.
 📱 TARGET SIM 
 Auto : Resolves the active data subscription and physical SIM slot.
 SIM 1 or SIM 2 : Applies changes to the selected SIM.
 Both SIMs : Offers mutually supported modes, applies changes to both, and reports partial failures.
 If Auto detection fails, select a SIM manually.
 🪄 SHORTCUTS & ROUTINES 
Create up to 4 capability-aware actions with custom names, modes, and SIM targets. Use app shortcuts, pin actions, or integrate with supported OEM routines.
 📡 BROADCAST AUTOMATION 
Integrate with Tasker, MacroDroid, Automate, and similar tools. External automation is disabled by default and requires opt-in.
 🔌 REQUIREMENTS & PERMISSIONS 
 Root or Shizuku Required : Either must be active and authorized. Shizuku is recommended and can run through Root, ADB, or Wireless Debugging. Trusted forks may add start on boot, watchdog, or TCP mode. Root supports Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, and compatible su solutions.
 Read Phone State : Optional permission for faster native SIM and capability detection. Without it, privileged shell fallbacks are used where available.
 Run at Startup : Briefly clears stale tile state after boot or app update. No persistent background service is used.
 Some root managers require manual authorization. Shizuku users must authorize NetToggle.
 🧠 SMART CAPABILITY FILTERING 
Evaluates device, SIM, and carrier information to hide unsupported modes. Both-SIM operation offers mutually supported modes. A registry helps hide legacy options on known 2G/3G sunset networks.
 🎨 DESIGN & THEMES 
Portrait and landscape layouts include guided setup and Auto, Light, Dark, and AMOLED themes.
 🛠️ DIAGNOSTICS 
Copyable reports include commands, exit codes, output, exceptions, execution state, and SIM resolution.
 💻 COMPATIBILITY 
Supports Android 7.0 and newer. Availability varies by Android version, OEM, ROM, modem, SIM, local network, and carrier.
 🛡️ PRIVACY 
 No advertisements, analytics, telemetry, or trackers.
 No Internet permission or transmission of user data.

fdroid:com.mkx.hrttracker.name: Featherline: HRT Tracker
fdroid:com.mkx.hrttracker.summary: Private medication tracker for HRT routines — plans, reminders, personal logs
fdroid:com.mkx.hrttracker.description:
Featherline is a thoughtful medication tracker built for people on long-term hormone therapy who want to keep their personal records private.
Everything you log — doses, schedules, personal notes — stays in an encrypted database on your device, under your control.
Track your routine, the way you actually live it
Build a personal medication schedule, daily or weekly. Get reminders at dose times, with quick actions to mark doses as taken, log them later, or note when you've taken something outside your plan. Your schedule, your records, your pace.
Visualize your routine
Featherline shows you how your dose timing flows across the day and week — visualizations help you see patterns in your routine. Set your own personal target ranges, mark your doses on a timeline, and check changes over the past 24 hours when you want a closer look. You can also record personal test results, and Featherline can calibrate the visualization to them, route by route, so it stays meaningful to you.
Designed with privacy in mind
- Local encrypted storage — your data stays on your device by default
- Optional app lock with biometrics or device password
- Optional screen content hiding for screenshots and recent apps
- Password-encrypted backup files you control — bring your records to a new device or keep an external copy
Features at a glance
- Custom medication schedules, daily or weekly
- Smart reminders with batch logging
- Routine visualization
- Calibration to your own test results, with a prediction interval on the chart
- Month-view history with personal summaries
- Personal record logging with built-in and custom fields
- Set your body weight for more personalized visualization
- Home screen widget — see your next dose and mark it taken right from your home screen
- Journal date widget and home-screen shortcuts with running day counts
- Medication stock tracking — keep count of what you have on hand, with low-stock reminders and a runway estimate so you can reorder before you run out
- Daily journal — note how any day went and track meaningful dates with milestones
About Featherline
Featherline is a personal tracking tool, not a medical device. The visualizations are based on the times and amounts you've logged, calculated using publicly available models. They're meant to help you stay organized and aware of your own routine. For any health decisions or interpretations, always consult your healthcare provider.

fdroid:com.tutpro.baresip.name: baresip
fdroid:com.tutpro.baresip.summary: VoIP and mobile calling and messaging app based on baresip library
fdroid:com.tutpro.baresip.description:
Baresip is security focused open source communication app for Android that originally only supported SIP based VoIP calling and messaging. Now baresip can also be chosen as Android's default mobile calling and messaging app. In addition, contacts are integrated within the app. Voice conference calls, voicemail indication as well as blind and attended call transfers are available when VoIP is used.
In VoIP calls audio can be coded with AMR, Codec2, G.729, G.722, G.722.1, iLBC, opus or PCMU/PCMA codecs. Security is achieved via TLS or WSS SIP signaling transport and ZRTP or (DTLS) SRTP media encapsulation.
Baresip app can be installed on Android devices running Android version 9 or later. Mobile calling and messaging needs Android version 10 or later. If you need video calling, you can instead of this app install its sister app baresip+.
Source code is available at GitHub , where also issues can be reported.

fdroid:de.happybuers.rechenzettel.name: Rechenzwerge
fdroid:de.happybuers.rechenzettel.summary: Counting and math practice for preschool and elementary school
fdroid:de.happybuers.rechenzettel.description:
Rechenzwerge is a practice app for preschool and elementary school kids. Older kids practice the times tables and the four basic operations, the youngest count quantities without any reading. Kids who do math collect math coins and can spend them in the games corner once parents enable it.
Practice math
- Times tables (2 to 10), addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, freely combinable
- Number range up to 10, 20, 100 or 1000
- Practice rounds with 10, 50 or 100 tasks, each task appears only once
- Mistakes are fine: try again or show the solution, nothing is given away on the first try
- Results with accuracy, total time, time per task and 1 to 3 stars
- "Practice again" repeats exactly the tasks that were answered wrong
- Best scores with a progress chart per level: shows whether tasks are being solved faster over time
Practice counting (for the youngest)
- Count quantities up to 5, 10 or 20, clearly laid out in rows of five
- Two modes: pick the dice pips or place objects on the counting board
- All choices are picture tiles, no reading needed
- After counting correctly, the matching number appears and is read aloud (can be turned off)
- Calm design: one motif per round, confetti only at the end
Mascot
- Build your own mascot: color, head shape, hairstyle and accessories, or randomly with "Surprise me"
- The mascot accompanies practice with a speech bubble and cheers for correct answers
Math coins and games corner
- Tasks solved correctly on the first try earn math coins: 10 tasks make 1 coin
- After every round, the results show how many coins were added and how many tasks are left until the next coin
- The games corner is off by default and is enabled by parents
- Three mini games: Egg catch, Space and Blocks
- 5 math coins buy 3 minutes of guaranteed play time
- After that the game continues as free bonus time until all lives are used up
- A running game is never interrupted
- The level goes up every 30 seconds, also during bonus time
Parent area
- Opened with a 3-second press and hold, optionally also protected by a PIN
- Daily limit for the games corner: 15 minutes
- Enabling the games corner
- Test credit for math coins (+1, +5, +25)
- Progress per game
And also
- No real money, no in-app purchases, no ads, no tracking, no permissions
- All sounds can be turned off
- All practice data stays on the device

fdroid:kapoue.hestia.name: Hestia
fdroid:kapoue.hestia.summary: Local control of Shelly devices — no cloud, no account, no tracking.
fdroid:kapoue.hestia.description:
Hestia controls your Shelly smart-home devices (Gen2 and later) directly on your local network, over HTTP, through their built-in API. No cloud, no account, no telemetry: nothing leaves your network, by default.
Features:
* Device dashboard: plugs, multi-outlet strips and smoke detectors, with state, consumption and switch. One tap opens a quick sheet, the full detail is one tap further.
* "On for X" timer executed by the device itself, fully autonomously (the phone can be turned off).
* Planning (recurring or one-time), with an optional power-threshold cutoff, for example at the end of a charge.
* Presence simulation: a script generated by the app runs on the device and switches on/off within a time window, with a random margin.
* Smoke detectors: state, battery, alarm mute, and the option to automatically cut a plug off during an alarm.
* Configurable physical button and LED on plugs.
* Firmware update from the app: check, install, restart the device.
* Backup and restore of your configuration in JSON format.
Options, all off by default and explained in Settings:
* Instant notifications via ntfy, sent by the devices themselves.
* Shelly Cloud: remote fallback for state and on/off, using your account key.
* Automatic firmware check, for devices that have Shelly Cloud enabled.
Privacy:
* Communicates only with the addresses you enter yourself.
* No network discovery, no tracking.
* The three options above are the only ones that send data outside your local network, and only if you turn them on.
* On Android 17 and later, the local network access permission is requested on first contact, preceded by a clear explanation.
Language: the app is available in French and English, and follows the system language (English by default, French if the device is set to French).
Independence: Hestia is an independent project, with no connection to Shelly or Allterco Robotics. It is neither commissioned, sponsored, nor endorsed by Shelly. No payment and no hardware were provided or lent by the brand. Shelly is a registered trademark of its respective owner; it is mentioned only for technical compatibility.

fdroid:net.tjado.usbgadget.name: USB Gadget Tool
fdroid:net.tjado.usbgadget.summary: Convert your Android phone to any USB device you like
fdroid:net.tjado.usbgadget.description:
USB Gadget Tool allows you to create and activate USB device roles, like a mouse or a keyboard. Connected USB hosts (e.g. a normal computer) will then identify your Android device only under that role. It can also be used to deactivate the standard USB Gadget (including mtp, adb, etc.), e.g. for security reasons.
Following USB gadgets are integrated:
* Keyboard & Mouse ( /dev/hidg0 , /dev/hidg1 )
* FIDO CTAP ( /dev/hidg0 ; for WebAuthn)
* CCID ( /dev/ccid_ctrl , /dev/ccid_bulk )
* UVC camera ( /dev/video? )
 USB Gadget Tool requires root permissions and a Kernel with ConfigFS support. Currently the app only enables the USB Gadget. For the usage of these device endpoints (e.g. /dev/hidg0 ) further apps are required.

firefox-addons:2972268.name: AI Chat Exporter - Free, Private, OpenSource
firefox-addons:2972268.summary: Privacy-first, 100% local tool to export or transfer AI chats from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity and 15+ models to Markdown, JSON, HTML, PDF, Word, PNG, or directly into Obsidian, Logseq, Bear or other PKM tools.
firefox-addons:2972268.description:
AI Chat Exporter is a fast, lightweight, and privacy-first browser add-on that lets you backup, export, and transfer your conversations from major AI assistants. With one click, convert entire conversational threads into clean Markdown (.md) , schema-compliant JSON , standalone HTML , PDF , Microsoft Word (.doc) , or shareable PNG images.
Seamlessly bridge your AI conversations directly into your Personal Knowledge Management (PKM) vault ( Obsidian, Logseq, Bear, NotePlan, Drafts ) or continue discussions across different AI models without losing context.
 100% Local & Privacy-First: No accounts, no servers, no telemetry, and no tracking. All parsing, rendering, and exports happen entirely within your local browser.
 One-Click Export: Download chats directly from your browser toolbar popup or Firefox sidebar.
 Clean Markdown (.md): Cleanly extracts headers, bullet lists, tables, inline images, code blocks, and LaTeX math.
 Structured JSON (.json): Exports normalized, schema-compliant JSON files with message roles, timestamps, model metadata, and full conversational trees.
 HTML, PDF & Word (.doc): Create standalone HTML documents with preserved styling, print-ready PDF files, or Microsoft Word (.doc) documents ready for editing.
 PNG Image Snapshots: Generate high-resolution visual snapshots of your chat threads using built-in canvas rendering.
 PKM Deep-Linking: Direct one-click URI transfer to Obsidian , Logseq , Bear , NotePlan , and Drafts .
 Cross-Model Continuation: Transfer active chat context directly to other AI platforms (e.g. continue a ChatGPT conversation in Claude, Gemini, or DeepSeek).
 Clipboard Rich-Text Copying: One-click copy formatted text or clean Markdown straight to your clipboard for instant pasting into Notion , Roam Research , Apple Notes , or email.
 LaTeX Math & Syntax Highlighting: Built-in KaTeX math engine renders block ( $$...$$ ) and inline ( $...$ ) equations cleanly; Prism.js provides crisp syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages.
 Reasoning & Thought Traces: Preserves thinking steps and chain-of-thought traces (e.g., DeepSeek-R1, Claude reasoning).
AI Chat Exporter features dedicated, high-fidelity parsers tailored for each platform:
 ChatGPT ( chatgpt.com ) — Full conversation trees, reasoning steps, Canvas artifacts, web search sources, and image attachments.
 Claude ( claude.ai ) — Multi-turn messages, thinking traces, code artifacts, and user attachments.
 Google Gemini ( gemini.google.com ) — Rich conversational turns, reasoning traces, tables, and citations.
 DeepSeek ( chat.deepseek.com ) — Full chat history, formulas, code blocks, and DeepSeek-R1 reasoning steps.
 Perplexity AI ( perplexity.ai ) — Structured answers, search queries, inline citations, and web source links.
 Google Search AI ( google.com ) — AI Overviews and AI search conversational threads.
 Microsoft Copilot ( copilot.microsoft.com & bing.com ) — Conversational answers, web references, and code blocks.
 Google AI Studio ( aistudio.google.com ) — Developer prompt sessions and model system responses.
 NotebookLM ( notebooklm.google.com ) — Grounded notebook outputs and citations.
 Google Cloud Assist — Cloud console chat assistant threads.
 Meta AI ( meta.ai ) — Multi-turn chats, generated text, and search citations.
 Mistral AI / Le Chat ( chat.mistral.ai ) — Chat threads, reasoning, and code blocks.
 Qwen ( chat.qwen.ai ) — Multi-language threads and code generation.
 Proton Lumo ( lumo.proton.me ) — Privacy-focused assistant chats.
 Z.ai ( z.ai ) — Conversation threads and outputs.
 Joyland AI ( joyland.ai ) & Chub AI ( chub.ai ) — Roleplay and creative character chats.
 Universal Web Articles — Extract any standard web article or documentation page into clean Markdown.
Connect your AI research directly to your second brain:
 Obsidian: Export notes directly via obsidian://new with custom note titles, folder paths, and configurable vault names.
 Logseq: Send formatted markdown blocks straight to your daily journals or pages via logseq:// .
 Bear Notes: Export rich markdown notes to Bear on macOS and iOS via bear:// .
 NotePlan: Create timestamped project notes via noteplan:// .
 Drafts: Seamlessly fire new quick captures via drafts:// .
 Notion, Roam, OneNote & Apple Notes: Use the Copy Rich Text button to paste cleanly formatted content with syntax-highlighted code and tables directly into your notes.
 No Remote Servers: The add-on contains zero backend servers, APIs, or telemetry endpoints.
 No Data Collection: We do not collect, store, inspect, or transmit your prompts, chats, API keys, or personal information.
 No Analytics / Trackers: No Google Analytics, no telemetry beacons, no third-party trackers.
 Local Storage Only: Your settings (e.g., default format, Obsidian vault name) stay stored in your browser's offline storage.
 Free & Open Source: Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0) . Full source code is public and auditable.
Built exclusively on trusted, battle-tested open-source components that run locally:
 decant-core: Modular parsing engine for AI platforms.
 Turndown.js: HTML-to-Markdown conversion engine.
 DOMPurify: Client-side HTML sanitization to ensure safe rendering.
 KaTeX: High-performance LaTeX math rendering engine.
 Prism.js: Syntax highlighting engine for code snippets.
 html2canvas: Local DOM rendering for PNG snapshot generation.
 Source Code: https://github.com/Covai-Labs/ACE 
 Official Website: https://ace.covai.org/ 
 Feedback & Issue Reports: https://ace.covai.org/feedback

firefox-addons:2888737.description:
CSS Insight - Inspect, Understand, and Test CSS Faster
CSS Insight is a lightweight browser extension for inspecting and testing CSS directly on webpages. Pick an element or enter a CSS selector to explore its styles without opening the full Developer Tools workflow for every quick check.
What you can do with CSS Insight:
• Inspect declared and computed styles
• Explore media rules, keyframe animations, nested CSS at-rules, and constructed stylesheets
• Select elements inside supported iframes and open shadow roots
• Copy CSS results to the clipboard or save them as a .css file
• Apply temporary custom CSS to preview design changes without editing the page source
• Open long results in a clean on-page details view
How to pick an element:
 Open CSS Insight and select “Pick an Element”.
 Switch to any supported webpage in the same browser window, then click or tap an element. The first selection is accepted, and the picker stops automatically.
 Return to CSS Insight. The generated selector appears automatically.
 Choose Declared Styles, Computed Styles, Media Rules, Keyframes, or apply your own CSS rule.
You can also enter any valid CSS selector manually.
CSS Insight works locally in your browser. It does not collect analytics or send inspected page data to a server.

apple-macos:1094587086.description:
Scriptation is the Emmy®-winning script annotation app trusted by directors, script supervisors, actors, development executives, and production teams on film and television sets worldwide, from prep through production.
"When I mark up my script, I use Scriptation now." (Kathy Bates)
"Scriptation changed my life. Every time you get a new draft, it transfers all your notes." (Sophia Bush)
The script changes. Your work stays with it.
FOR DIRECTORS & WRITERS
Organize your entire prep in one digital production binder.
• Annotate scripts with highlights, notes, photos, Apple Pencil drawings, and audio
• Transfer markups to new revisions automatically in seconds
• Use layers to separate personal, department, and meeting notes
• Insert facing pages, shot lists, set plans, and reference images
• Create and share daily sides directly from the app
• Listen to your script read aloud with customizable character voices
• Keep scripts, call sheets, schedules, and production documents in one place
No more 3-ring binders. No more rewriting notes when revisions land.
FOR PRODUCTION & DEPARTMENTS
Break down scripts, tag elements, and generate reports.
• Tag props, wardrobe, locations, VFX, SFX, and more with custom categories
• Generate formatted breakdown reports as PDF or CSV
• Include photos, reference notes, and scene details
• Integrate with planning apps like Cinapse, SetHero, Shamel Studio, Shot Lister, and Think Crew
• Transfer tags to new revisions so breakdowns stay current
Perfect for assistant directors, department heads, producers, and anyone else on set who interacts with a script.
FOR SCRIPT SUPERVISORS
Professional lining and continuity tools built for production.
• Generate instant scene coverage tramlines
• Add facing page reports and mark takes directly in the script
• Maintain continuity notes across scenes and revisions
• Transfer lining and notes when new drafts arrive. Nothing lost.
Built for how modern script supervisors actually work on set.
FOR ACTORS
Prepare for auditions and rehearse scenes, no scene partner needed.
• Highlight your character's lines in one tap
• Rehearse with customizable character voices and scene looping
• Use Playback Mode as a self-tape teleprompter with slate delays
• Transfer your annotations when new drafts arrive. No rewriting.
Whether you're prepping sides, running lines, or recording a self-tape, Scriptation turns your script into a rehearsal studio.
FOR DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVES
Evaluate scripts faster. Listen to them, mark them up, and share notes.
• Listen to scripts with distinct character voices to hear dialogue, pacing, and tone
• Use it as a table read on the go between meetings or during a commute
• Annotate scripts as you read or listen
• Share note layers with creative teams while keeping personal notes separate
Whether you're reading for a greenlight or giving notes on a draft, Scriptation lets you experience the script, not just read it.
SCRIPTATION INDUSTRY PRO
Unlock the full production toolkit across all your devices.
Industry Pro includes advanced Note Transfer, multi-layer transfer, collate pages, compare scripts, breakdown tagging and reports, facing pages, daily sides, script supervisor lining tools, advanced layers, collaboration, and rehearsal tools for actors.
Premium AI features and AI voice access may require a separate AI subscription.
Scriptation offers optional auto-renewing subscriptions, including Industry Pro and AI access, with monthly and/or annual options where available. A free 14-day trial may be available for eligible offers.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Apple Account Settings.

Read your daily news more smoothly and conveniently.
Newsdaily, a powerful & sophisticated news reader, automatically presents each news page in a clean and readable manner with its built-in optimizer engine. Articles are displayed extremely quickly and text size, font, and themes are completely customizable for easy reading.
Sources are Google News RSS feeds, so you can get the latest news from thousands of publishers in one place, from more than 70 countries/regions in 27 languages. Any story can be found by entering keywords.
Newsdaily clipping functions gives you the ability to store interesting articles on your device. You can classify clippings by folder to read later.
Key features:
- No setup is required. Once you start up Newsdaily, you receive the latest news.
- The Newsdaily optimizer quickly displays clean and readable pages. All ads or unnecessary links are drastically reduced.
- It’s also possible to easily switch between the usual display and the optimized display.
- Search for news stories with keywords.
- Save articles to your device.
- Add custom news categories that you frequently check.
- Dropdown menus from by long-pressing will gives easy access to related news and allows for easy article sharing.
- Darker Themes available for night reading 
- Universal: Available for the iPhone and the iPad!
- Customizable gestures, full screen for iPad mini, multi-functional image viewer, history, star articles, are among the specific features for Apple mobile products.
- Keyword-based source filtering.
